notes.title: Among Golf Episode has finally landed 🍳
notes.content:
Expect betrayal, vending machines, surprises, space rockets, UFOs, vents, cats and other vaguely related items that are great for golfing!

I hope you like it, we had a lot of fun making it 🤘

notes.title: Live on Twitch with Ivar the Boneless
notes.content:
What do Vikings and golf have in common?
Not a (w)hole lot. But we are now live and playing with Ivar the Boneless from the show Vikings.

Come hang out with two handsome vikings on Twitch: Actor Alex Høgh Andersen and Developer Rune K. Drewsen in this funny stream.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/tribandtv]JOIN ON TWITCH![/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33709509/f0c10c2dfecaade30ce01196e8b449f8a7446b50.gif[/img]

It’s a charity event for the Red Cross, so for the next 24 hours all sales from WHAT THE GOLF? goes to the Red Cross.👋
